documentTitle: SERA — Standardised European Rules of the Air, Regulation (EU) 923/2012

sections.notes: SERA.3225 Operation on and in the vicinity of an aerodrome: observe traffic, conform/avoid traffic pattern, left turns unless otherwise indicated/instructed, and wind-preferred landing/take-off.
SERA.6005 Requirements for communications and SSR transponder in RMZ/TMZ airspace.
SERA.7001 General objectives of air traffic services.
SERA.7005 Coordination between aircraft operator and air traffic services.

SERA.8005 Operation of air traffic control service. Three top-level paragraphs (a/b/c): (a) what an ATC unit shall do (4 numbered duties); (b) which classes of flight separation must be provided between (5 numbered cases plus exception); (c) separation methods (vertical / horizontal with sub-cases). Clean clause hierarchy.
SERA.8010 Separation minima. Compact: (a) ANSP selects minima; (b) coordination between neighbouring airspaces; (c) notification of minima to ATS units and pilots.

SERA.8015 Air traffic control clearances paragraphs (a)-(d): (a) basis of clearances, (b) operation subject to clearance with sub-numbered cases, (c) potential reclearance, (d) contents of clearances (5 numbered fields). The (e) readback paragraph already covered separately as readback_8015_e.
SERA.8015(e) Read-back of clearances and safety-related information. Compact regulatory text: four numbered sub-paragraphs (1)-(4) with the always-read-back list (i)-(iv) nested under (1).
SERA.8015(f) Coordination of clearances: route coverage, downstream clearances, and controlled-airspace scope. Hardened in clearance_comms_2026-04-30.
SERA.8020 Adherence to flight plan: controlled-flight adherence, amended clearance, emergency deviation, and requested change content. Hardened in clearance_comms_2026-04-30.
SERA.8025 Position reports: controlled-flight reporting duty and data-link exception. Hardened in clearance_comms_2026-04-30.
SERA.8030 Termination of control: duty to advise ATC when no longer subject to ATC service. Hardened in clearance_comms_2026-04-30.
SERA.8035 Communications: continuous voice watch, two-way communication as necessary, CPDLC persistence, and comms-failure reference. Hardened in clearance_comms_2026-04-30.
SERA.9005 Scope of flight information service.
SERA.9010(a): ATIS use in directed request/reply transmissions, aircraft acknowledgement, current altimeter setting, current-ATIS omission rule, and stale-ATIS update rule.

SERA.9010(b)(1)-(11): combined arrival/departure ATIS message elements for aerodrome name, arrival/departure indicator, D-ATIS contract type, designator, observation time, expected approach type, runways in use/arresting-system status, runway surface/braking action, holding delay, transition level, and other essential operational information. Split from the broad combined ATIS contents window after final v7 exposed defense-pass density.

SERA.9010(b)(12)-(13): combined arrival/departure ATIS message elements for surface wind, runway/section-specific wind indication, visibility/RVR, and CAVOK footnote context. Split from the broad combined ATIS contents window after final v7 exposed defense-pass density.

SERA.9010(b)(14)-(21): combined arrival/departure ATIS message elements for present weather, cloud/CB/vertical visibility, air temperature, dew point, altimeter settings, significant meteorological phenomena, trend forecast, and specific ATIS instructions. Split from the broad combined ATIS contents window after final v7 exposed defense-pass density.

SERA.9010(c)(1)-(11): arrival-only ATIS message elements for aerodrome name, arrival indicator, D-ATIS contract type, designator, observation time, expected approach type, runways/arresting-system status, runway surface/braking action, holding delay, transition level, and other essential operational information. Split from the broad arrival-only ATIS window after final v7 exposed defense-pass density.

SERA.9010(c)(12)-(16): arrival-only ATIS message elements for surface wind, visibility/RVR, present weather, cloud/CB/vertical visibility, air temperature, and CAVOK footnote context. Split from the broad arrival-only ATIS window after final v7 exposed defense-pass density.

SERA.9010(c)(17)-(21): arrival-only ATIS message elements for dew point, altimeter settings, significant meteorological phenomena, trend forecast, and specific ATIS instructions. Split from the broad arrival-only ATIS window after final v7 exposed defense-pass density.

SERA.9010(d)(1)-(10): departure-only ATIS message elements for aerodrome name, departure indicator, D-ATIS contract type, designator, observation time, runways/arresting-system status, runway surface/braking action, departure delay, transition level, and other essential operational information. Split from the broad departure-only ATIS window after final v7 exposed defense-pass density.

SERA.9010(d)(11)-(17): departure-only ATIS message elements for surface wind, visibility/RVR, present weather, cloud/CB/vertical visibility, air temperature, dew point, and altimeter settings. Split from the broad departure-only ATIS window after final v7 exposed defense-pass density.

SERA.9010(d)(18)-(20): departure-only ATIS message elements for significant climb-out meteorological phenomena, trend forecast, specific ATIS instructions, and CAVOK footnote context. Split from the broad departure-only ATIS window after final v7 exposed defense-pass density.
SERA.11005 Service to aircraft in the event of an emergency, including maximum consideration/assistance/priority and unlawful-interference handling.
SERA.12015 Reporting of aircraft observations by voice communication.
